craft_notes: Sthāyin: remover-praise (adepts' feet, humble pain lifted). Rows: row 3 (adored→praise). Close: praise (refrain). Rejected: 'remover' noun — killed: lifter kept (apahṛta as verb-acted, present); 'Vata' short — killed: Vaṭuka kept whole (name never clipped).

lines: His foot-pair by choice heroes, yoginī crowds, siddha rows adored —
lifter of humble folk's pain, apāna-named Vaṭuka, praise.

reads_against.argmap: Who guards with him? → Vaṭuka as apāna-gatekeeper: worshipped by adepts, remover of disciples' knots and doubts (Dyczkowski).
c1_essence: Vaṭuka apāna-named, worshipped by adepts: remover of the humble folk's pain and doubt.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
